title: Rioni Valley Namakhvani rotating vigil and January 30 removal

start_date.summary: January 31 report says protesters had taken shifts for 98 days. Establishes a pre-January vigil, not an exact first physical date or threshold.

crowd_dispersal.summary: Police removed the protest tent from the construction site January 30; concrete clearing phase. Actual success is not required by manual 229–232. No inference that the whole campaign ended.

notes: Prior-month rotating vigil opposing the Namakhvani dam's environmental/social impacts. January 30 police tent removal is retained as a response phase, with no January reset. 98 days is duration, not crowd size. Tent removal/minor skirmish does not establish beatings or whole-campaign closure. Exact onset and owner month remain unresolved.

title: Batumi Adjara Government House election protest camp
notes: Opened November 9 Batumelebi report establishes an already continuing overnight tent protest over October31 election results, demanding renewed elections. January 15 TV25 discovery describes24-hour continuation but original returned403; opened January 25 News Georgia also describes an indefinite government-house protest. Exact first day/owner month and January concurrent threshold remain unknown. NewYear celebration is not a new protest or a January onset.

title: Tskhinvali custody-death accountability vigil
notes: CrisisWatch Georgia entry explicitly says early-December protests continued throughout January in Tskhinvali's main square seeking prosecutor resignation and custody-death accountability. Small-scale attendance, de-facto territorial/state-target mapping and primary-source verification remain unresolved; no automatic inclusion under Georgia. August custody death motivates this vigil and is not January killings. Proposed mediation by former officials is not an actual government meeting.

title: Parliament rear-entrance November–December tent predecessor
notes: Opened RFE body describes a second consecutive day with overnight tents outside Parliament; retrospective timeline identifies November 30 curfew/political-prisoner protest. Exact initial day and uninterrupted January survival are unverified. Retained as an ownership trace for January 8/24 civic actions, not an asserted continuous January observation.
